title: Auto-scaffold DSL from reference skeleton before inference
description: In batch.py, before launching each member inference session, automatically call reference_scaffold to generate a starter DSL. Agent refines from 50-60 percent similarity instead of starting from scratch. The reference_scaffold tool already exists. Should be technique-aware: coons_cage scaffold for coons_cage members, curve_sweep scaffold for curve_sweep members.
definition-of-done: batch.py writes a scaffold DSL to the member output.dsl before inference begins. Agent sees the scaffold file and refines it. Initial checkpoint similarity starts at 40+ percent instead of 0.
testing-plan: Run a single batch member with auto-scaffold enabled. Verify output.dsl contains scaffold code before first inference round. Verify first checkpoint similarity is higher than without scaffold.
